card.name: The word overdose in warning statements
card.fires_on: The word "overdose" in the standard warning "In case of (accidental) overdose, call a doctor or poison control center". It also fires weakly on a few unrelated spots, such as Malay "di" before a verb.

modes.label: Overdose warning
modes.description: The word overdose right after "In case of" or "accidental" in a keep-out-of-reach-of-children warning.
modes.example: In case of accidental<< overdose>>, call a doctor or poison control center

modes.label: Malay passive "di"
modes.description: The passive prefix "di" before a verb in Malay text.
modes.example: Buku ini telah<< di>> tulis 140 tahun dah

card.plain: It marks the word overdose in the usual warning to call a doctor or poison control, and also shows up in a few odd places in other languages.
